findings.title: KeyError when integration metadata has no 'sender'
findings.body: `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` assumes the `sender` key always exists. `build_integration` only sets `metadata["sender"]` when the pipeline state contains `sender` (i.e. when the installation webhook was processed), so pre-existing Integration rows and installs where the webhook didn't populate sender will raise KeyError/TypeError, producing a 500 error instead of the intended friendly failure page. Use `integration.metadata.get("sender", {}).get("login")` and treat a missing value explicitly.

findings.title: get_user_info failure is unhandled
findings.body: `get_user_info(payload["access_token"])` is called outside any try/except. If GitHub returns a non-200 (revoked token, rate limit, outage) this raises (e.g. ApiError) and the installation flow returns an unhandled 500 rather than rendering the github-integration-failed page like the other failure branches. It also assumes the return value is a dict supporting `in`.

findings.title: Non constant-time comparison of pipeline signature
findings.body: `request.GET.get("state") != pipeline.signature` compares a user-supplied value against a secret-derived signature with `!=`, which short-circuits on the first differing byte. Use `django.utils.crypto.constant_time_compare` to avoid leaking information about the signature through timing.

findings.title: test_installation_not_found no longer tests the 404 installation path
findings.body: The test now sends `state=ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05`, which does not match the pipeline signature, so the request fails at the new state check in OAuthLoginView and asserts the generic "Invalid installation request." message. The original assertion ("The GitHub installation could not be found." from `build_integration` on a 404 from /app/installations) is therefore no longer exercised at all; that error path is now untested. Use the correct state so the flow actually reaches the installation lookup, and add a separate test for state mismatch.

findings.title: No test for missing/failed access_token exchange or missing sender metadata
findings.body: The new failure branches in OAuthLoginView (token exchange returning no `access_token`, `get_user_info` returning no `login`) and the GitHubInstallation branch where `integration.metadata` lacks `sender` are untested. Given these are the security-critical paths this PR adds, tests covering a failed/reused `code` and a metadata-without-sender integration should be added.
